_about: Words flagged for the scholar's review after comparing the transcriptions with the page scans. kind: 'ocr' = the transcription differs from the scan; 'print' = matches the scan but is probably a printing error; 'verify' = the scan is unclear. 'match' is the exact text highlighted in the section; 'suggest' (optional) is offered as a one-click replacement.

016.note: मुद्रणे 'श्र्व' दृश्यते — the scan shows श्वश्र्वा (instrumental of श्वश्रू, 'by the mother-in-law'); the र is missing.
Padaccheda repeats the same missing र: श्वश्र्वा.
The scan appears to print बध्वा, but the absolutive of बन्ध् is बद्ध्वा (the padaccheda already has बद्ध्वा). Keep the printed form with a मुद्रणदोषः note, or correct it.

022.note: मुद्रणे अनुस्वारः — the scan prints an anusvāra (मोचयं-स्ततो), not a candrabindu.
The scan may read सङ्घर्षे’ (with e-mātrā). Please check the print; सङ्घर्ष इति (nominative with visarga dropped) is also grammatical.

023.note: कालम् is accusative here, so कञ्चित् is expected; the print uses ञ्च, which is easily misread as श्च (see the same phrase on pages 024 and 025).
पुरुषम् is the object of अभाषत, so कञ्चित् (accusative) is expected; likely the ञ्च / श्च confusion.
The scan appears to read व्याचक्षे-. व्याचख्ये (perfect, 'he explained') is the grammatical form here; confirm what the print has.

024.note: मुद्रणे 'कञ्चित्' — the scan clearly reads कञ्चित्कालमुषितैः.
बिल ('tunnel, hole'); ब्रिल is not a word. The padaccheda already has बिल-मार्गेण.

025.note: मुद्रणे 'कञ्चित्' — the scan clearly reads कञ्चित्कालं गमयामासुः.

027.note: मुद्रणे 'ठि' — the scan reads उत्कण्ठिताः; the इ-mātrā is missing.
